answer: Shards are assigned from the prism graph, so that cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The velvet assignment is published and nebula records each panel. The grading quorum of 9 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so a hostile operator cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 2858 identities would post 4304 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
